confidence_notes: Coffee and restaurant anchors rest on national averages and aggregator estimates (Daily Brew Report 2026, travel and cost-of-living guides), so they are moderately reliable. Beer is a bounded estimate from national pub-price ranges. Cocktail and wine are inferred from the beer anchor because no direct 2026 cocktail or wine data was found. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and regional context; no booking pages or current listings were inspected. The FX value is a third-party report of the 18 November 2026 RBA print (0.6720); the RBA F11.1 table itself could not be retrieved, so the source_url is the official RBA exchange-rates page and the value should be verified against F11.1.
comparable_city_reasoning: Priced as a regional NSW coastal city, slightly below Sydney and close to national averages. Restaurant costs are about 1.7% above the Australian national average per MyLifeElsewhere, while overall living costs are slightly lower. Accommodation is benchmarked to regional Australian coastal towns with similar tourism demand.
